# Scheduling blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Scheduling blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## reminders

Recurrence rules and reminders. Expansion follows RFC 5545 in TypeScript. Delivery is a job that records reminder.sent once per occurrence.

- Title: Reminders
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/reminders
- Client: `remindersBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/reminders`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `queue`
- Works with: `notifications`, `outbox`, `subjects`
- Entities: `reminder`
- Tables: `reminders`
- Permission keys: `reminders.manage`, `reminders.read`
- Events (`RemindersEvents`): `reminder.sent`
- Consumes: `notifier (optional)`

## calendar

Calendars, events with RFC 5545 recurrence (RRULE, EXDATE and per-occurrence overrides) and attendees, working hours, out-of-office and focus-time blocks, and a free/busy query that counts approved leave. Series expand in TypeScript with the reminders block's expandRule and in SQL for free/busy; a share link serves an iCal feed.

- Title: Calendar
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/calendar
- Client: `calendarBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/calendar`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `recurrence`
- Works with: `share-links`, `reminders`, `outbox`, `leave`, `organizations`
- Entities: `calendar_event`, `calendar`
- Tables: `calendar_events`, `calendars`
- Permission keys: `calendar.manage`, `calendar.write`, `calendar.read`
- Events (`CalendarEvents`): `calendar.created`, `calendar_event.created`, `calendar_event.purged`, `calendar_event.updated`

## bookings

Bookable resources with weekly hours and exceptions, services with durations and buffers, and bookings that a gist exclusion constraint (btree_gist) keeps from overlapping per seat. Holds expire; recurring series book every occurrence; a share link opens public booking; confirmed bookings mirror into the calendar and reminders.

- Title: Bookings
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/bookings
- Client: `bookingsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/bookings`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `recurrence`
- Works with: `queue`, `share-links`, `rate-limit`, `calendar`, `reminders`, `outbox`
- Entities: `booking`
- Tables: `bookings`
- Permission keys: `bookings.manage`, `bookings.create`, `bookings.read`
- Events (`BookingsEvents`): `booking.archived`, `booking.cancelled`, `booking.confirmed`, `booking.expired`, `booking.reserved`, `booking.restored`

## passes

Admission passes on QR codes and NFC tags, signed with the signing-keys block: a ticket for a booking or a pass with a number of uses for a resource, a log of every scan, class credits that pay for bookings and come back on an early cancellation, and drop-ins counted against the resource's capacity with its bookings.

- Title: Passes
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/passes
- Client: `passesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/passes`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `bookings`, `signing-keys`, `ledger`
- Entities: `pass`, `pass_check_in`
- Tables: `passes`, `pass_check_ins`
- Permission keys: `passes.read`, `passes.manage`, `passes.check_in`
- Events (`PassesEvents`): `pass.admitted`, `pass.issued`, `pass.rejected`, `pass.revoked`

## recurrence

An RFC 5545 expander in SQL: rrule_occurrences lists the instants a rule starts in a range and rrule_next gives the first after an instant, matching the TypeScript expander in better-supabase/recurrence.

- Title: Recurrence
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/sql
- Modes: `managed`
